title: Turret distribution
description: Plan turrets, captains, reserve players and the final distribution.

limits.tierZeroHint: A higher tier has a greater nonzero cap than a lower tier. 0 = unlimited. Caps apply only to helpers.
limits.flexibleDescription: Move Any-shift players to a specific shift within the turret planner only. Remember the shared 100-player shift capacity. Registrations remain unchanged. Restore returns only unassigned players to Any shift: captains and helpers keep their turret placements.
limits.notEnoughFlexible: There are not enough unassigned Any-shift players for this move.
limits.quotaExplanation: For Wasteland, players from different original alliances join ONE shared alliance. Each shift has a maximum of 100 seats in total, including captains. You can set a lower cap if needed.
limits.tierAutoDescription: No manual caps: the planner uses each player’s actual march. When filling turrets, helper marches may be reduced to fit more players.
limits.tierCustomDescription: Custom march caps for helpers. A player’s actual march is never increased.
limits.noEnabledTiers: No tiers are enabled in registration settings.
limits.autoHint: Each tier has no manual cap. A helper’s assigned march cannot exceed their actual march, and total helper marches cannot exceed the captain’s rally.

feedback.applied: Players were moved in the turret plan. Changes will save automatically.
feedback.restored: Restored availability of unassigned players. Shift limits unchanged.
feedback.appliedCount: Moved to specific shifts: {{count}} players. Draft updated.
feedback.restoredDetails: Returned to Any shift: {{restored}}. Kept in turrets: {{kept}} (captains and helpers unchanged). Shift limits preserved.
feedback.restoredNoPlayers: No unassigned transferred players to return. Kept in turrets: {{kept}}. Captains, helpers and shift limits unchanged.
feedback.noChanges: Enter the number of players to move.
feedback.invalidCount: Enter a valid whole number of players.
feedback.notReady: Wait for the draft to load.

limits.globalHelpersDescription: One default for every turret in every shift. Individually configured turrets keep their own limit.
limits.globalHelpersHint: Default: 29. The captain is separate. Lowering the limit does not automatically remove assigned players — resolve any excess manually.

turret.settingsAndLimits: Turret settings · march limits by tier

planner.loadFailed: Failed to load the player table.
planner.noPeriod: There is no active registration cycle
planner.readonly: You do not have permission to edit distribution settings.
planner.manualNote: Limits apply to automatic assignments. Public plan and registrations remain unchanged.
planner.otherShiftNotice: There are {{count}} registrations with an unknown shift. Review them in the players table.

errors.unavailable: This player is unavailable for the selected place, shift, or troop type.
errors.helpersPresent: Move helpers back to reserve before changing the captain.
errors.full: This turret has reached its helper limit. Change the turret setting or free a slot.
errors.noRoom: The captain has no free rally capacity.
errors.shiftFull: No seats remain in the shared Wasteland alliance for this shift. The absolute maximum is 100 players including captains (or a smaller custom cap).
errors.invalidFields: Check the nickname, tier, troop type and numeric fields.

manual.confirmClear: Clear “{{tower}}”? All its players will return to the local plan reserve.
manual.capacityNote: Total helper marches cannot exceed the captain rally size. Assignments do not edit D1 registrations.
manual.waitForPlayers: Wait until the active cycle and player list finish loading.
manual.chooseTurret: Choose a turret on the Turret settings tab
manual.rulesConflict: Conflicting assignments: {{count}}. Check shift, captain eligibility and troop type. Move affected players to reserve or correct the rules on the Settings tab.
manual.confirmReconcile: Update outdated assignments to match current registrations? Changes will first be saved only in this browser.
manual.staleNotice: Some assignments are outdated after registration changes.

server.previewNotice: Preview of the working distribution. Players will see it only after you press Publish.
server.confirmPublish: Publish the completed distribution for all players? This will replace the previous publication.
server.confirmRestore: Replace the current working plan with the last published version? Unsaved changes may be lost.
server.ownerAdminOnly: Only Owner and Admin may publish.
server.saveFirst: Review registration changes and assignment conflicts first.

messages.published: Final plan published for the current cycle.
messages.restored: Last published plan restored to the draft. The public plan is unchanged.
messages.conflict: Another administrator edited the shared plan. Your local work remains in this browser. Use “Load shared plan” to replace it.
messages.stale: Player data has changed. Review assignments before saving.
messages.periodChanged: Registration cycle changed. Reload the page.
messages.saveFailed: Could not save plan to D1. Local work remains in this browser.
messages.publishFailed: Could not publish the plan. Review the data and try again.
messages.restoreFailed: Cannot restore the published plan (registrations may have changed).
messages.loadFailed: Could not load the draft. Check your connection and retry.
messages.localRestored: Unfinished work was restored from this browser. Other admins cannot see it yet.
messages.sharedSaved: Work plan saved for other administrators. Public plan is unchanged.
messages.sharedLoaded: Shared plan loaded from D1. Previous local changes were replaced.
messages.rosterAcknowledged: Registration changes reviewed. Check assignments before publishing.

auto.title: Automatic distribution
auto.description: Fill preserves manually assigned players and marches. Redistribute reassigns helpers, while keeping every captain in place.
auto.manualDisabled: Automatic actions are unavailable in Manual mode. Choose Balanced or Maximum march.
auto.confirmRedistribute: Redistribution first releases every helper in every enabled shift, then assigns helpers again. Captains remain in place. The same player may return to the same turret when still eligible. The public plan is unaffected. Continue?

messages.autoFilled: Filled: {{captains}} new captains and {{helpers}} helpers. Reserve: {{reserve}}.
messages.autoRedistributed: Redistribution: {{released}} helpers released; {{helpers}} assigned again. Moved to another turret: {{moved}}, returned to the same turret: {{same}}, returned to reserve: {{returned}}.
messages.autoTowerFilled: Turret filled: {{captains}} new captains and {{helpers}} helpers.
messages.autoNoChange: No eligible players or remaining capacity. Your draft is unchanged.
messages.manualMode: Automatic distribution is not available in Manual mode.
messages.autoBlocked: Wait for loading, reconcile stale registrations and fix assignment conflicts first.
messages.autoRedistributedIssues: Redistribution: {{released}} released; {{helpers}} assigned again (moved: {{moved}}, same turret: {{same}}). Remaining conflicting assignments: {{conflicts}}. Review captains and rules before saving or publishing.
messages.helpersCleared: All {{released}} helpers returned to reserve. Captains were kept. Use “Fill turrets” to assign helpers again.
messages.helpersAlreadyEmpty: There are no helpers to clear. Captains remain unchanged.

auto.shortDescription: Higher tiers first, then higher march within the same tier. Top-up preserves assignments; redistribution retains captains.
auto.marchesAdjusted: Automatically recalculated marches for {{count}} previously assigned helpers.
auto.confirmClearHelpers: All helpers from all turrets in every enabled shift will return to reserve. Captains and their positions will stay unchanged. This only changes your local browser plan; the public plan is unaffected. Continue?

workspace.localOnly: Saved in this browser · Not shared with admins
workspace.shared: Shared version is up to date
workspace.conflict: Another admin updated the shared plan
workspace.storageError: Browser could not save the local changes
workspace.confirmReload: Replace this browser's work with the current shared plan from D1? Unsynced local changes will be lost.

towerEditor.planOnly: Changes apply only to the turret plan. Registration submissions remain unchanged.
towerEditor.manualNote: Not in registrations? Add a player to this planning draft only.
towerEditor.zeroTierHint: 0 keeps the current march for this tier. Recalculation only affects the selected turret and shift.
towerEditor.invalidFields: Check the nickname, tier, troop type and numeric fields.
towerEditor.saveRejected: Changes could not be applied. Check rally capacity, captain eligibility, troop type and placement availability.
towerEditor.noReserveCandidates: No available reserve players for this turret.

publicationDiagnostics.noPermission: Only an owner or administrator with distribution permissions may publish.
publicationDiagnostics.notReady: Wait until registrations and the plan have loaded before publishing.
publicationDiagnostics.rosterChanged: Registrations changed. Review the assignments and click “Reviewed” in the heading, then save and publish.
publicationDiagnostics.conflicts: The plan has incompatible assignments. Fix the affected players or redistribute the turrets.
publicationDiagnostics.stale: Some assignments became stale after player changes. Review and remove incompatible entries.
publicationDiagnostics.remoteConflict: Another administrator saved a newer shared plan. Preserve your changes before loading it.
publicationDiagnostics.apiError: Server response: {{code}}. Check that your Worker is updated and inspect the Network tab.
